provider.name: Project Observatory
provider.description: Local project inventory and agent memory with configurable private data sources. Bundled schemas describe wire compatibility; external host admission is unverified.

capabilities.name: estate.survey

assertions: result validates against capability-output.schema.json
counts.projects == 1 and projects[0].id equals the requested id
membershipRules has exactly one entry per repository
evidence is non-empty and every entry resolves to a registry source id
degraded is present, even when empty
registry git status and ledger max revision are unchanged after the call
result validates against capability-output.schema.json
every repository returned is one the project's notes name or a link verified by hand
every repository of that owner which is absent is absent because it anchors its own project
every returned repository is named in a membershipRules entry
with the event store unreachable the call still returns a typed result
degraded names the store and its reason
degraded names each bitbucket workspace whose listing was not read, carrying the collector's own reason; it is silent when every workspace was listed
repositories known only from a local remote carry discoveredBy=local-remote-only

capabilities.description: Return the typed state of every project in a scope. Deterministic: filesystem, git, GitHub and Bitbucket listings and the projects wiki, merged under named rules. No model participates, so the same scope over the same machine returns the same survey.

capabilities.name: project.detail

probes.description: A bounded probe against an explicitly selected synthetic fixture workspace.
assertions: result validates against project-detail-output.schema.json
the requested project is the one returned
every section is present, so an empty one means measured-and-empty
a note carries the state that qualifies it, never a bare sentence
a finding says whether it is about the project or one of its repositories
registry git status and ledger max revision are unchanged after the call

capabilities.description: Everything known about ONE project: identity and membership rules, the weekly activity series, the latest measurement of every plugin metric, the conclusions the observatory has drawn (each with the state that qualifies it), and the findings open against the project or its repositories. Every section degrades on its own — a store that will not open does not remove the registry's half of the answer.

capabilities.name: project.timeline

probes.description: A bounded probe against an explicitly selected synthetic fixture workspace.
assertions: result validates against project-timeline-output.schema.json
every event carries occurredAt, never the store's column name
the payload is an object, not a JSON string the caller must parse
the events are newest first
registry git status and ledger max revision are unchanged after the call

capabilities.description: Commits and recorded events for one project, newest first, paged by `limit` and bounded by `since`. Payloads arrive parsed: a host must not have to know how this system serialises one.

capabilities.name: project.record
capabilities.description: Append a note about a project, or propose a change to the typed registry. Both land as proposals: the ledger accepts state 'proposed' from an automated writer and nothing else, and a registry proposal never touches registry/*.json. Neither call can approve its own proposal.

assertions: the probe runs against a scratch store; no row reaches the operator's ledger
a well-formed write is accepted in state 'proposed', never higher
a write with no owner is refused before the ledger is touched
a stale expectedRevision returns RevisionConflict carrying the current revision
another owner's record cannot be corrected: OwnerRefused
a registry proposal leaves registry/projects.json byte-identical

capabilities.name: machine.mcp.inventory

probes.description: A bounded probe against an explicitly selected synthetic fixture workspace, which takes no inventory of its own.
assertions: result validates against mcp-inventory-output.schema.json
degraded is present, even when empty
a server row carries only name, declaredIn, transport, answers, status and checkedAt
an empty server list always comes with a degraded row saying why
registry git status and ledger max revision are unchanged after the call

capabilities.description: Every MCP server the agent configs on this machine declare (Claude Code user and project scopes and its plugins, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kiro), by name, with the configs that declare it, its transport and whether it answered the last probe, and when. Names and verdicts only: no URL, command line, header or environment value is read into the answer. Read from the last inventory the observatory took; an absent or unreadable config, and an inventory older than the tick allows, are named in degraded.

capabilities.name: machine.mcp.refresh

probes.description: A bounded probe against an explicitly selected synthetic fixture workspace, which configures no agent config to read.
assertions: the call answers a job handle whose status is working
fabric.job.get reaches completed within the probe timeout
the completed result is an envelope whose output validates against mcp-inventory-output.schema.json
fabric.job.get for an id this agent never issued answers isError with unknown-job
registry git status and ledger max revision are unchanged after the call

capabilities.description: Take a new MCP inventory now: re-read every agent config and ask Claude Code to probe the servers it knows. The probe health-checks each server and can take minutes, so the call answers a job; the finished job's result envelope carries a machine.mcp.inventory answer as its output. A refresh already running is joined, not started twice. Observation only: nothing outside the observatory's own scan file changes.
